definitions.explanation: A two-wheeled motor vehicle. In Japanese, バイク typically refers to motorcycles rather than bicycles.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はバイクで{通勤|つうきん}している。
バイクの{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}りたい。
examples.english: I want to get a motorcycle license.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}はバイクでツーリングに{行|い}く。
examples.english: On weekends, I go touring on my motorcycle.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
- In Japanese, バイク refers to motorcycles/motorbikes, not bicycles ({自転車|じてんしゃ}).
- This is a false friend for English speakers who might expect "bike" to mean bicycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バイクに{乗|の}る (to ride a motorcycle)
- バイクで{行|い}く (to go by motorcycle)
- バイクの{免許|めんきょ} (motorcycle license)
- バイクツーリング (motorcycle touring)
- {原付|げんつき}バイク (moped, small motorcycle)

RELATED TERMS:
- {単車|たんしゃ} (motorcycle, more masculine/casual term)
- オートバイ (motorcycle, more formal term)
- スクーター (scooter)
